foyer: The Foyer holds a few things you want to meet again: who you are becoming, how you want life to feel, and the season you are living now.
landscape: The Landscape looks across life areas through Vision; Identity, values & feelings; Decisions; Practices; and Structure & strategy.
season: A season is a gentle boundary around what matters now. It can hold priorities, experiments, practices, support, and what is deliberately Not Now.
uncharted: Uncharted is for possibilities that do not need a plan yet. Begin with “What if…?” and let the idea remain open.
reflection: Reflection Garden gathers what you are learning, celebrating, and seeing differently over time. It is where the Studio begins to remember with you.
